_note: Tower climb hud layout, in 1920x1080 pixels. Colours are [r, g, b, a] from 0 to 255. text_nudge moves the texts inside their glyph boxes.

chain._note: center_x: the chain's middle; top: where the top ropes start, just above the screen; rope_gap: the rope length between two planks (the first plank hangs first_extra lower); hole_inset: the rope holes, from the plank's ends and edges

title._note: the title is at most its plank's width less text_margin wide

floor._note: gap: between the flap and the '/k' text; the number is at most the flap's width less text_margin wide

lives._note: gap: between the label and the bar. The bar has one segment per life, a plain bar from plain_from lives up; segments are gap px apart for up to up_to lives (the first entry that fits), touching beyond. It is blue while the lives are above blue_above of the most, yellow from yellow_from, red below (and on the last life).
